data.name: Mal
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Mal is recorded in name-lists as “Little”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mal expresses “Little”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mal total 8, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: מַלְאָךְ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words 'mal' meaning 'messenger' or 'angel' and 'ach' meaning 'my God'.

in_greek.name: Μάλαχ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek words 'mala' meaning 'my' and 'akhos' meaning 'angel' or 'messenger'.

in_latin.name: Malachias
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin words 'mal' meaning 'my' and 'achias' meaning 'angel' or 'messenger'.
